name: Profile
descr: The picture profiles: the recipes a derived picture is made by. A profile holds one of two kinds of size: width and height - an exact size, or resolution - megapixels spread over the shape of each picture. A picture is sized in this order: size_base takes the area as it is and reads no size of the profile; else width and height; else resolution in the shape of the area; over 50 megapixels nothing is painted; size_optim keeps an area smaller than the size on both sides; smart lets the canvas take the shape of the area, else the rest of the canvas is background - the picture itself is never stretched; border makes the picture smaller by two margins along its long side. A profile is a row of the FILES_PROFILE dictionary, but its body is XML of the program's editor, so it is read and written here, in plain words. The area is the whole picture here - a frame is cut by hand in the program only; everything else a profile keeps. A mask is a value of FILES_MASK in the base settings with a picture hung on it by the Files tool - entity key_value, elem_id the id of that value.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the profiles, every recipe in plain words.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a profile: the name and a size are asked for - width and height, or resolution for pictures that keep their own shape; the rest of the recipe takes its defaults. The word of the profile is what CmdMake of the Files tool runs by.

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the profile - the word people and CmdMake call it by

params.name: type
params.descr: jpeg, png or webp - what the derived picture is written as

params.name: quality
params.descr: 4..100, the compression of the picture

params.name: width
params.descr: the width of the derived picture, px, 10..50000; width and height together are the size

params.name: height
params.descr: the height, px, 10..50000

params.name: resolution
params.descr: megapixels, 0.01..50, for pictures that keep their own shape - instead of width and height

params.name: smart
params.descr: on - the canvas takes the shape of the area; off - the canvas is the size, the rest is the background; the picture is never stretched

params.name: size_base
params.descr: the derived picture takes the size of the area; the size of the profile is not read

params.name: size_optim
params.descr: an area smaller than the size on both sides keeps its own size, and the canvas with it

params.name: group
params.descr: the group (kind_key) the derived file lands in on its element

params.name: group_base
params.descr: the derived file keeps the group its source already has; group is not used

params.name: range
params.descr: 0..255 - grey up to this level is repainted into the background; 255 touches nothing

params.name: range_border
params.descr: 0..100 - the band around the silhouette where the wash fades out, ten final pixels to the unit; 0 cuts hard

params.name: border
params.descr: the picture inside the canvas is made smaller by two margins along its long side, px

params.name: background
params.descr: #RRGGBB - the colour behind the margins and the wash

params.name: canvas_alpha
params.descr: what the wash takes goes to transparency and the file is written with alpha; png and webp only, jpeg ignores it

params.name: rotate
params.descr: -180..180 degrees

params.name: mirror
params.descr: mirror the picture

params.name: mask
params.descr: the mask by its name - a value of FILES_MASK in the base settings with a picture hung on it by the Files tool; empty or none - no mask

params.name: mask_pos
params.descr: center, left-top, right-top, right-bottom or left-bottom

params.name: mask_alpha
params.descr: 0..255, how see-through the mask lies

params.name: intensive
params.descr: -255..255, the brightness

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Takes one profile out of the registry; a profile the program relies on is refused. Pictures already derived by it stay where they hang.

params.name: name
params.descr: the profile to take out

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused
